Neo ECO GOLD ZEN500W
Efficient & Affordable
The new NeoECO Gold ZEN series features high performance with an 80 PLUS Gold rating, achieving up to 92% efficiency and gives you savings unheard of from other power supplies. Featuring a 120mm whisper-quiet high-quality fan and CircuitShield™ Industrial Grade Protection-all backed up by our 5-year Antec Quality Warranty, NeoECO Gold ZEN series offers a highly efficient, affordable power solution.
Antec 5-Year Warranty
We stand by the quality and safety of the NeoECO Gold ZEN Supplies, offering a 5-year parts and labor warranty and unlimited access to our incomparable technical support and customer service.
Japanese Heavy-Duty Caps
Japanese capacitors ensure the tightest DC stability and regulation, for reliability that you and your system can count on.
LLC + DC to DC Design
A server-class Half-Bridge LLC design with a synchronous rectification based on a DC-DC topology.
120 mm Silent Fan
Features a Thermal Manager, an advanced low voltage fan control for optimal heat & noise management and will allow your PSU to stay at an optimal temperature.
99% +12V Output
Engineered with high-quality capacitors and low-noise transformers, the NeoECO Gold ZEN series provide clean, stable power with maximum CPU & GPU support
